verdict: RESOLVED: Todoist's 'Filters & Labels' entry never renders a count (confirmed with 3 filters / 0 labels). meologue's entry renders NO count at 0/0, and renders a LIVE COMBINED count (filters + labels summed) as soon as either category is non-empty -- 1 filter alone -> '1', 1 filter + 1 label -> '2', 1 label alone -> '1'. This corrects/refines the operator's parenthetical guess ('I observed the entry render 1 with 1 label and nothing with 0') into a fuller, confirmed model: zero at 0/0, and a running sum otherwise. On headings: confirmed meologue still lacks a 'My Filters' heading (matches the operator's suspicion) while Todoist has 'Filters & Labels' + 'My Filters' + 'Labels'.
